title: Candidate queue sprintlist — Sofia Chen
content:
Morning triage (10am standup notes)

Primary goal: clear the 48-hour follow-up backlog and lock interview times for next week. Tight on calendar slots — prefer 9:30–11:30 PT and 2:00–4:00 PT windows for panel interviews.

Today's time blocks
- 09:00–10:00: Batch candidate outreach (emails + Slack DMs). Use templates below; personalize 1–2 lines.
- 10:00–10:30: Sync with Diego — pipeline exceptions (visa, timezone conflicts).
- 10:30–12:00: Schedule interviews (matchers: Zoe, Priya). Prioritize candidates with recruiter score >= 7.
- 12:00–13:00: Lunch w/ buffer for reschedules.
- 13:00–14:00: Confirm interviewers + send prep notes + rubric links.
- 14:00–15:00: Candidate debriefs for yesterday's interviews (collect feedback).
- 15:00–16:00: Office hours / open scheduling slot for hiring managers.
- 16:00–17:00: Wrap: update tracker + follow-up outstanding threads.

Priority candidate follow-ups (action + deadline)
- Priya K. (SWE backend) — action: confirm take-home assessment time, candidate prefers evenings PT, needs 48hr window. Deadline: 2026-04-11 18:00 PT.
- Marco R. (PM) — action: send panel availability options 4/14–4/16, include hiring manager Caleb. Deadline: 2026-04-10 17:00 PT.
- Asha T. (Data Eng) — action: escalate visa start date question to legal (ticket JIRA-RECRUIT-842). Deadline: 2026-04-11 EOD.
- Remote on-call candidates list (5 ppl) — action: opt-in confirmation + timezone overlap check. Deadline: 2026-04-12.

Scheduling heuristics / reminders (things I keep forgetting)
- Always include candidate local time in invites (add in parentheses).
- If candidate is >8h offset, propose two slots and label them "late evening" or "early morning" to set expectations.
- Use "shared calendar slot" only for asynchronous take-homes, not live interviews.
- For panel interviews, add 10-min pre-brief line to invite (Zoom link + rubric URL).

Templates (short, personalize 1 line)
- Quick availability ask:
  "Hi {name}, hope you’re well — can you share 2–3 times that work for a 45-min interview next week? We typically schedule between 9:30–11:30 PT and 2:00–4:00 PT. Thanks! — Sofia"

- Reschedule confirmation:
  "Thanks for the heads up — I’ve moved your interview to {new_time} ({candidate_tz}). Please let me know if the new slot works. Panel includes: {names}. Prep packet: {link}. — S"

- Failed-to-reply nudge (48h):
  "Hi {name}, checking in on my note below re: interview availability. If now isn’t a great time, happy to pause and reconnect later — just let me know. — Sofia"

Edge cases / notes to self
- Candidate asked if we accept later start dates — list common answer options (immediate, 1–2 months, flexible). Keep script ready for hiring managers to avoid long back-and-forth.
- If hiring manager requests hours outside top windows, suggest split interview (panel partial overlap) rather than pushing candidate to odd hours.
- Keep an eye on repeat no-shows from same timezone cluster — flag for follow-up policy (3 strikes -> hold).

Tracker quick commands (use with Google Sheet)
- Column notes abbreviated: status P=phone screen, I=interview, O=offer, W=withdrawn.
- Quick filter: status in (P,I) AND last_contacted < 2026-04-08 -> urgent follow-up.

Open questions / items to escalate
- Can Legal confirm the visa FAQ paragraph we use for external candidates? (Ping: legal@redwood)
- Should we provide a one-click timezone converter link in invites? (Product asks vs recruiting UX).
- Hiring manager feedback turnaround SLA — move from 72h -> 48h? Discuss in Friday sync.

Evening wrap (what I need to finish before sign-off)
- Send Marco availability + lock at least two PM panel slots.
- Confirm Priya's take-home window and create assessment invite.
- Update sheet with outcomes and add 'next-contact-date' for each candidate.

Random quick wins to implement this week
- Add template macro for "candidate local time" to Gmail canned responses.
- Create a small checklist doc for interviewers (copy/pasteable) to reduce last-minute question threads.

Notes to future-me
- If you’re reading this months later: check if we rolled out 48h feedback SLA. If yes, delete this doc. If not, remind Diego to follow up.

---
Raw scratch area (copied from slack threads / to tidy later)
- @caleb agrees to 4/15 slot AM PT; will confirm panel names by EOD.
- Candidate Marco prefers 4/16 if possible but also said he can do 4/14 morning.
- PM rubric link: https://confluence.company/recruiting/pm-rubric (add to invites)
- Slack thread: #recruiting-coords thread id: C0248K9

End of notes.
